newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-WORLD CUP CALLUP FOR BAGGIO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WORLD CUP CALLUP FOR BAGGIO.

text.p: AC Milan star Roberto Baggio received a surprise call-up to Italy's World Cup squad on Thursday.
Baggio, 30, has 45 Italian caps but last played for the national team as a second-half substitute in a 1-0 European Championship qualifying win against Slovenia in September 1995.
Coach Cesare Maldini has called in Baggio as cover for Chelsea striker Gianfranco Zola, currently not 100 percent fit, ahead of next Wednesday's World Cup qualifier against Poland in Naples.
